articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Iran Wars Fuels RTX Growth Story as Defense Demand Rockets Higher. RTX Corp (NYSE:RTX) reports its first-quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, April 21, prior to market open. With the Iran War now driving a surge in missile demand and a $268 billion backlog in hand, this quarter is a direct test of whether RTX can convert geopolitical urgency into accelerating earnings.
